entries.gap: KLU fails on a large mixed deck (17 block instances, HBT and PSP MOS): the singular pivots change from run to run (PSP noise nodes).
entries.symptom: The operating point falls back to a transient op and fails.
entries.workaround: Use the sparse solver (.options klu off) for whole-chip DC points. The same blocks pass with KLU alone.
entries.evidence: whole-chip DC point of a reference design (sparse passes at three corners, KLU fails)

entries.gap: Monte Carlo DC points with reltol 1e-4: 21 of 300 seeds need the transient-op fallback, 4 have no DC point from Newton. The cause is the solver, not the circuit.
entries.symptom: Seeds without a DC point, or fallback snapshots with large offsets.
entries.workaround: Use reltol=1e-3 and itl1=1000 for the operating points of a Monte Carlo run (300 of 300 seeds converge); state the options.
entries.evidence: Monte Carlo of an IF amplifier block of a reference design

entries.gap: The npn13G2 card has self-heating (selft=1) with a thermal time constant of about 5 ns.
entries.symptom: Transient values drift for tens of ns.
entries.workaround: Read transient results after more than 25 ns, or set selft=0 for method comparisons (state it).

entries.gap: The antenna diode model has a jump near 3 n Vt (a discontinuity) that can stall transients of pad circuits.
entries.symptom: 'timestep too small' near zero diode voltage.
entries.workaround: Leave the pad antenna diodes out of the transient deck when the pad is not under test, and state it.
entries.evidence: pad circuit transients of an earlier design

entries.gap: In a transient, the VBIC instance vectors @q[ib] (and, to a smaller part, @q[ic]) of npn13G2 include the charge currents of the junction capacitances; they are not the conduction currents.
entries.symptom: A shot-noise PSD 2 q |i| from these vectors is too high: in a 61.8 GHz VCO the base shot noise was 24 dB and the collector shot noise 1.7 dB above the result with the conduction currents.
entries.workaround: Take the conduction currents from a DC table of the device at the junction voltages of the transient (@q[vbe], @q[vbc]), and give them as a psd_a2_hz list per phase of the oscillator operation.
entries.evidence: simulated, ngspice 46: oscillator operation with shot vectors against the stored conduction-current result of the same deck
